FINAL FOR PUBLICATION

Substitute

Type-1 Zoning Map Amendment
3301 W. 55 Street

From C1-1 to B2-3

1.A. The applicant seeks a zoning change from C1-1 to B2-3 to allow the construction
of 4-story multi-unit housing buildings with dwelling units on the ground floor.
The proposed building site is a Transit-Served Location (TSL).

fence separations and setbacks for vehicular parking as shown on the site plan.

districts.
